# SDLC-FR-0301 — Export audit events

## Requirement

Authorized users can export audit events for a chosen date range as a downloadable file.

## Detailed Behavior

The export contains every audit event whose time falls within the chosen range, in time order. An export request from a user who is not authorized is refused.

## Rationale

Operators need audit evidence outside the service.

## Acceptance / Verification

An authorized user receives a file with exactly the audit events of the range; an unauthorized user receives a refusal.

## Constraints & Edge Cases

The set of users or roles authorized to export audit events is not defined by this Requirement.

## Non-Goals

Does not define the file format beyond being downloadable.

## Open Questions

None.

# SDLC-FR-0302 — Record audit events

## Requirement

Every administrative action on the service must be recorded as an audit event.

## Detailed Behavior

An audit event records the action, the acting identity and the time. Audit events cannot be modified or deleted through the service.

## Rationale

Administrative actions must be traceable.

## Acceptance / Verification

Every administrative action produces exactly one audit event.

## Constraints & Edge Cases

Audit events never contain secrets.

## Non-Goals

Does not define which actions are administrative beyond service configuration changes.

## Open Questions

None.
